sections.title: Know what you are granting
sections.summary: OAuth authorizes Segmently to read your products and prices and to create new ones inline in the product dialog. You are not granting direct charge access; all charges run through your connected Stripe account.

sections.title: If products do not appear
sections.summary: If your Stripe products or prices are missing in the picker, verify you selected the matching mode and that the products exist in that Stripe account, since test and live are separate catalogs. Refresh the page or reconnect OAuth if needed.

sections.title: Why test and live need separate connections
sections.summary: Stripe Connect Standard accounts require separate OAuth connections for test and live because each mode has its own account ID and API keys. This is a Stripe limitation; connecting test first is the recommended safe pattern.
